interpretation.low: Lower than expected glycemic index. May indicate hypoglycemia risk or anemia.
interpretation.normal: Normal average blood glucose control over the preceding 90 days.
interpretation.elevated: Prediabetes range. Increased risk for type 2 diabetes. Lifestyle changes recommended.
interpretation.critical: Elevated diabetic range. Suboptimal glycemic control requiring clinical consultation.

interpretation.low: Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia). Consult physician if symptomatic.
interpretation.critical: Elevated fasting blood sugar in diabetic range.

interpretation.low: Below normal range. Often related to low muscle mass.
interpretation.elevated: Mildly reduced renal clearance. Requires follow-up hydration check.
interpretation.critical: Significantly impaired kidney filtration. Immediate nephrology evaluation recommended.

interpretation.low: Low urea level. Usually benign; may correlate with low protein diet.
interpretation.elevated: Elevated blood urea. May indicate dehydration or altered kidney clearance.
interpretation.critical: Markedly elevated blood urea. Potential acute or chronic renal compromise.

interpretation.elevated: Mild hepatocellular irritation. May be associated with fatty liver or medications.
interpretation.critical: Marked hepatic enzyme elevation. Medical investigation needed.

interpretation.elevated: Mild elevation. Can arise from liver stress or vigorous exercise.
interpretation.critical: Significant transaminase elevation. Clinical assessment indicated.

interpretation.elevated: Borderline high total cholesterol. Dietary attention advised.
interpretation.critical: High total cholesterol. Elevated cardiovascular risk factor.

interpretation.low: Low HDL cholesterol. Associated with reduced cardiovascular protection.

interpretation.critical: High LDL cholesterol. Statin therapy or lifestyle change often evaluated by physician.
High triglyceride level. Pancreatic and vascular risk consideration.

interpretation.low: Low hemoglobin. May indicate anemia, iron deficiency, or blood loss.
interpretation.normal: Healthy oxygen-carrying capacity in red blood cells.

interpretation.low: Leukopenia. Lowered immune response or marrow suppression.
interpretation.elevated: Leukocytosis. Often reflects reactive immune response to infection or inflammation.
interpretation.critical: Markedly elevated WBC. Urgent evaluation for acute infection or hematologic condition.

interpretation.low: Thrombocytopenia. Bleeding risk; monitor for petechiae or bruising.
interpretation.elevated: Reactive thrombocytosis. May reflect secondary inflammation.

interpretation.low: Suppressed TSH. Potential hyperthyroidism or medication effect.
interpretation.elevated: Subclinical hypothyroidism. Thyroid underactivity requiring evaluation.
interpretation.critical: Marked hypothyroidism. Hormone replacement consultation recommended.
